articles.title: Gene-edited beagles may offer a future option for people with dog allergies - AP News
articles.description: Scientists at a biotech company have used gene editing to create two hypoallergenic beagles that don't trigger allergies. Using a Nobel Prize-winning editing tool called CRISPR, they switched off a gene that produces the main allergy-causing protein in dogs. …
articles.content:
NEW YORK (AP) Matt Walker couldnt pet a dog without sneezing until he and other scientists used a gene editing technique to produce a hypoallergenic beagle named Bailey.
